recipe: Pork steaks, sweet potato mash & greens
servesNote: 2 portions — ~900 kcal / ~70 g protein each, the highest protein-per-effort dish in the library at ~12 minutes hands-on.
adaptations: ⛔ DAY 4 — THE LAST FRESH-MEAT DAY, and pork loin steaks are the shortest-dated fresh meat in the shop. Check the use-by when you buy it and cook them on it, not after. Fresh pork smells of almost nothing and feels dry-ish and firm; sour or faintly ammoniac, or slippery and tacky, bin it.
✅ THE SWEET POTATO IS IN THE HOUSE — Tuesday bought 1 kg — and so are green beans (2 × 220 g). ⛔ The pork is not, and neither is broccoli.

⭐ THIS IS AN OLDER, LEANER CARD than the researched ones. If you want the full treatment of the same cut — the dry brine, rendering the fat edge, and the salsa verde — cook 'Pork loin steaks with mint & parsley salsa verde' instead. It is the same protein done properly and takes 25 minutes longer.

ingredients.prep: ⛔ check the use-by — see the adaptations
steamed until bright and still firm
in the pan, and a little into the mash

equipment.why: ⭐ the pork rests on it, and the rest matters more than the cooking time

equipment.item: A steamer or a pan with a lid

prep: Peel and chunk the sweet potato. ⚠️ Open the pork and check it before anything else — the use-by is the whole decision on this day of the week.

steps.text: Hot pan, oil, pork. Leave it until it releases cleanly from the pan and is deep gold. Turn once.
⭐ Rest it before serving. This matters more than the cooking time.
Mash with a little olive oil, salt and pepper. Greens steamed until bright and still firm.
